correctness.rationale: A fully queried length-m window can receive the forbidden trace, so cannot occur in a shattered support. Conversely set all free sites to one and inspect consecutive zeros. Every bad gap of distance m−1 has queried zero endpoints and some unqueried interior site, since its whole window is not queried. Inserting a zero there destroys just that bad gap and creates only smaller gaps. One can do this once per initially bad gap; no new bad gaps need to be considered. The cyclic argument includes gaps across the boundary, and there is no bad gap with at most one zero when n≥m. This proves shattering for every trace, including the empty path and n=m on the circle. Avoidance of 1^m gives the same support test by filling free sites with zero; this is not language equality. The bounded-run compositions on either side of path separators give the path coefficient and generating series. On the cycle, marking an unselected coordinate counts each size-k support n−k times, establishing the n/(n−k) factor without assuming rotation freeness. Minimum separator counts follow from disjoint blocks on the path and packing n−q selected sites into q runs of length ≤m−1 on the circle; both bounds are attained. Independent direct trace projections on 24 cases for r=2,3,4 agreed with the support tests and VC dimensions and reproduced both displayed n=9, r=2 coefficient lists.
residual_risks: Replay is finite; the construction proves the arbitrary-length statement. No conclusion for n<m cyclically or for several simultaneous forbidden factors.

evidence: The trigram theorem covers all eight length-three factors, including the excluded 010 line case. The length-four record studies 0011, not 0110; its support automaton and period differ. The partial-word publisher abstract describes avoidable binary patterns in partial words, not a stated arbitrary-coordinate completion criterion for this literal family.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Length-three coverage does not reach r≥2. Reversal and bit complementation preserve 0110's palindrome property and cannot give 0011; no longer-factor or cyclic covering theorem was identified in these statements.

evidence: Prior 010 coincidence is a finite-pattern length-three result. The inspected de Bruijn existence formulation does not decide the closed form for every support. General bounded-run counts require a separate identification with extendability of arbitrary prescribed bits.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: For longer isolated runs, the zero-gap repair is what excludes additional global obstructions in both boundary models. Neither the trigram result nor a generic existence algorithm gives the uniform closed criterion or its path/cycle comparison.

value.rationale: An unbounded family of nonmonochromatic obstructions has exactly the same coordinate-query complex as simple run avoidance, although the concept languages differ. The extension mechanism makes that equivalence explicit and yields a sharp one-rank loss from periodic boundaries at every nonmultiple, as well as all support counts. This is structural information about completion, not just a recounted bounded-run sequence.
residual_risks: The proof is specific to a single isolated run; it does not establish a general palindromic-factor replacement law.
